Meanwhile, Erica befriends Calvin's sick mother to gather information about his new relationship. Tragedy strikes as Candace is found murdered, and Calvin becomes a suspect. To add to his troubles, he learns that Erica manipulated his mother into changing her will.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Jade is an ambitious career-woman, dreaming of a VP title and to go up against her male counterparts. She dreams of finding a man her equal, but wants to focus on her career. Her perspective begins to change once she meets the new mailman Scott, but everyone in her life has their own intentions as well.

programme.title: He'll Never Let Go
programme.desc: Candace's life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with the charismatic Karlton Moore. At first glance, Karlton seems like the epitome of perfection—his looks, charm, and achievements paint an irresistible picture. However, as their relationship deepens, Candace begins to unearth a chilling truth. Karlton harbors a sinister darkness and an overwhelming fear of commitment. What initially appeared as a dreamy romance soon transforms into a harrowing nightmare.

programme.title: Heavy
programme.desc: When being young and hood rich is no longer a priority Renz turns his focus to something physically and mentally finer. But when walls and barriers begin to break, things begin to get HEAVY and he realizes he has to choose between love and loyalty.

programme.title: Heavier
programme.desc: After a tragic night in the city, lovers, friends and family are forced to take on the dominating forces. Many are left to choose life or death.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city’s most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka “Bunny & Clive”. When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: She's Watching
programme.desc: Richard and Zoey have recently moved into their dream home, only to find themselves being watched by an obsessed neighbor. Watching them every night isn't enough to satisfy her urges, so she makes an offer they can't refuse.

programme.title: He Killed My Sister
programme.desc: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Campaign of Deception
programme.desc: Arie Hinkley has it all - A beautiful family, a husband who is about to be mayor, money, friends, the perfect life. Until a stranger from her past returns to reveal a mysterious and disturbing past from Arie that not only threatens her husband Booker Hinkley's campaign but may very well ruin Arie's dream life.

programme.title: Vampire Genesis
programme.desc: Half-alien Teh'a flees across galaxies, hunted by a race of parasitic rulers disguised as Earth's vampires. With rebels by her side, she seeks a legendary creature: the first vampire, powerful enough to end their reign of terror.

programme.title: Twerk: Reggae Nights
programme.desc: Hard-working, single mother, Iesha, learns that one of the most popular reggae artists, Domino, is holding an audition in her city for dancers in his next music video. The competition is fierce, and some of the ladies will do anything to get the job.

programme.title: Weapons of Warfare
programme.desc: When 19 year old TJ, decides to leave the nest of his parents who are preachers of the gospel and turns to the streets for the love and support he always wanted. His life is turned upside down almost over night with gun violence, drug dealings, stolen money and countless crimes in the blink of an eye. His life becomes a tug of war between the parents that raised him and his new gang leader chief Who’s bringing him further down to the ground.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Double Standards
programme.desc: A upstanding perfect couple of their community church 'First Lady Trezjiir Jonez a devoted wife, of Pastor Noble Jonez, that lives a unknown double life, decides to engage in pre-marital counseling sessions in their unstable home, where sexual desires of hidden thirsty passion enter as a fatal demise' will the sin be forgiven or will it be the ultimate judgment day

programme.title: Double Standards 2
programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez’s carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface—ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties—every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: All the Love
programme.desc: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can’t fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust. Will she find love or suffer the same mysterious fate as her birth parents?

programme.title: Office Secrets
programme.desc: Alvin work at a grueling corporate job, where he is constantly under foot of his drug addicted, gambling boss. He crosses paths with Victoria, who recently freed herself from a betrayal from her husband, but has an agenda all her own. Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: No Disrespect
programme.desc: Milk has run the streets efficiently in his father’s absence. After 15 years in prison, his father Bull, has returned to claim what is rightfully his.

programme.title: Perc 30
programme.desc: Shavonne Perkins has taken control of the biggest Percocet operation in Houston, TX. Her father Bapo, the head of the Perkins crime family, is in the midst of transferring his entire drug operation over to his youngest son, Brandon, knowing that the other children will not take the news lightly. Soon after the announcement, a price is put on the entire family's head. Bullets fly, lives are lost, and the family look to each other as to which one of them is responsible.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Vixen
programme.desc: Dewayne's sexual fantasies begin to take a life of their own when he begins to push his wife into being a vixen. With his consent, she has multiple sexual partners. Dewayne knows his wife will do anything to satisfy her husband, for her chance at motherhood. Things begin to be more than either of them bargained for. Who is the pawn in this game of sexual gratification?

programme.title: Mama's Hands
programme.desc: A woman, who was abused as a child by her mentally ill mother, sets out on a journey to find healing through forgiveness. She discovers that she may be too late.

programme.title: Kill em with a Smile
programme.desc: Happily married Jessica has accepted that she is going to die from a terminal illness, and isn’t afraid of death. Her real fear however, is her husband Reginald falling back in love with his ex Rebecca, and stealing the life she built.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.desc: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty. 20 years later, now a detective, ghosts from her past resurface, and she must face these demons once again.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Blue Typhoon attempts to save a small ship caught in the crossfire between them and the Metarex. Unfortunately, the pilot aboard the spaceship was Decoe, who was acting as a decoy to lure Sonic into the path of Megarex fleet led by Dr. Eggman.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin is in Monaco to race his new toy in the Monaco Grand Prix. Or so he thought. Lupin ends up losing both his money and race car in a fixed poker game at the casino. Then, Fujiko tells Lupin about a fixed race, suggesting that Lupin should enter it to turn the tables on the man who cheated him, while also stealing the enormous betting takes. Who will be laughing at the finish line?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A rare bottle of Bordeaux, commissioned by Napoleon for his beloved wife, Josephine, is to be given to the President of the United States as a Christmas present. Lupin and his gang decide to steal the wine while it's being transported over the Atlantic, but Inspector Zenigata stands in their way. Who will be celebrating come Christmas?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elric brothers adjust to military life and take part in a manhunt for the dangerous Isaac the Freezer, a former State Alchemist bent on bringing Fuhrer Bradley down.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: A glimpse into the past reveals the pain and desperation that drove the Elric boys to break alchemy's greatest taboo - human transmutation - and their reasons for becoming dogs of the military.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie - Memories of Nobody [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: An evil clan is sending the World of the Living and the Soul Society on a collision course. Can Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers save the two worlds from annihilation?

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chaotix still aren't able to find their home. Upon taking a wrong turn in space, they've landed on a planet where they are now running a café in order to raise money for the ship's repair. All seems to be going (relatively) well when Dr. Eggman shows up with an offer of reward for Sonic and his crew's capture.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Blue Typhoon is under attack by Yellow Zelkova who is equipped with a special energy shield built by Dr. Eggman. Sonic and his crew are sent crashing down to a nearby planet where Knuckles and Sonic attempt to destroy the powerful weapon.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A criminal gang has hidden a microfilm containing the manufacturing process for artificial diamonds, developed by NASA, in one of Inspector Zenigata's molars. Determined to get his hands on that microfilm, Lupin must capture Inspector Zenigata, who now believes that he is seeing hallucinations of Lupin everywhere. Can Inspector Zenigata's mind handle this bizarre reverse chase?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Howard Heath, the world's richest man, suddenly dies a mysterious death and leaves a large ruby to Fujiko in his will. After inheriting the ruby, Fujiko comes down with the same mysterious fever as Hees. The ruby, in fact, had been stolen from a cult temple in the Caribbean. Lupin must return the ruby in order to save Fujiko, but the cult has something in store for Lupin, as well! Will Lupin and Fujiko be able escape the cult's wrath?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Science and faith collide when the Elrics confront Father Cornello. He claims to work miracles, but the brothers suspect he is abusing a Philosopher's Stone to manipulate his flock.

programme.desc: The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.

programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Shadow breaches Blue Typhoon, appearing in Cosmo's room. As he knocks Sonic and Chris unconscious, Shadow goes after Cosmo whom Tails has taken away to safety.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Blue Typhoon is mysteriously transported to an abandoned planet as Cosmo discovers that Metarex are monitoring what she sees and hears through a chip that is implanted in her. As Tails and Chris try to find a way to remove Cosmo's chip, Amy and Rouge discover that the planet is Cosmo and Metarex's home planet.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Count challenges Lupin to steal a gemstone named Dracula's Tear from on board his airship, the Hendenburg. However, also on board the Hendenburg are several formidable detectives: Sherlock Holmes III, Philip Archer, Kosuke Kindani and Inspector Zenigata. Will Lupin accept the Count's challenge and will he be able to complete the task before the airship lands, where the police will be waiting for him?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin is suffering from Transformation Sickness, an illness that transforms him into a cruel, cold-blooded criminal at the stroke of midnight, and leaves him with no recollection of his murderous crime spree in the morning. In despair, Lupin even contemplates taking his own life, but is the "other Lupin" really Lupin?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Right on schedule, Kid the Phantom Thief makes his move to steal Marie Antoinette's cat's-eye ring off the hand of Inspector Nakamori... but has the French cat burglar Chat Noir already made the first move? And will either one of them be able to escape the "inescapable cage"?

programme.title: From Other Worlds
programme.desc: A depressed Brooklyn housewife sleepwalks through her life until she is abducted by UFOs. Determined to solve the mystery of her otherworldly experiences, she embarks on a journey that leads to both romance and a new meaning of life. Starring Cara Buono, Jay Oakerson, Isaach De Bankolé

programme.title: Generation Wolf
programme.desc: Generation Wolf talks about a young entrepreneur who is about to lose his business and choose to grow marijuana as an easy way to save it. But soon enough he realizes that crossing the line could have extreme consequences into his life. Starring Christian de la Cortina, Hayley Sales, Michael D. Cohen

programme.title: Hidden Moon
programme.desc: The son (Wes Bentley) of a wealthy man whose funeral is disrupted by the presence of a mysterious Latin American woman (Ana Serradilla), sets out to salvage his family's reputation by figuring out the exact nature of the woman's relationship with his deceased father. Starring Wes Bentley, Ana Serradilla, Johnathon Schaech

programme.title: Holy Hustle
programme.desc: Cain McGee finds himself alone after the death of his mother and untimely break-up with his girlfriend. Things go bad to worse when his often invisible, con man brother who only return home to get his hands on his portion of the inheritance--or so he thinks.

programme.title: Furious
programme.desc: Featuring now-classic fight choreography and bizarre special effects, "Furious" has been pirated by fans all over the world since its first release in 1984. Now digitally remastered and with commentary by Writer/Director Tim Everitt, this favorite of critics and fans alike.

programme.title: Homes on the Range
programme.desc: Witness a community come together to solve the issues facing their small town as they work to ensure their elders are taken care of properly and in a sustainable way.

programme.title: Homestate
programme.desc: The unexpected appearance of an estranged uncle disrupts a family's routine and sets off a series of events that expose underlying issues, inadequacies, and suspicions.c

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: A forensic photographer retreats from the world after witnessing the aftermath of a bizarre murder. When a similar murder occurs, he is asked by a detective to help unravel the mystery that involves corpses drained of blood, peculiar and unexplainable feathers and antique photographs that appear to capture his beautiful neighbor decades before she could have been alive.

programme.title: Impossible Crimes
programme.desc: An experienced detective investigates a series of implausible murders. Things get a turn when a young nun, Caterina, confesses that she believes herself to be the killer.

programme.title: Brain Dead
programme.desc: The story of six people caught in the unusual (except in horror films) predicament of being stranded in a deserted fishing lodge with a host of alien-infected, mutant amoeba-controlled zombies at their doorstep.

programme.title: Blood and Steel: Cedar Crest Country Club
programme.desc: The story of an 80’s skateboarding mecca, tucked in the woods of a country club, that drew some of the best up-and-coming skaters and punk bands from across the country. From the mouths of the rebels who lived it, hear how one ramp became a legend. - Starring Tony Hawke, Ian MacKaye, Bucky Lasek

programme.title: Blue Family
programme.desc: Based on true events, Blue Family follows the charming used car salesman Armando as he works on creating a perfect family. For underneath his sunny disposition, lies a dark secret. In an attempt to make up for a childhood of abuse and the family he never had, he hand picks his own family by kidnaping three attractive young women.

programme.title: Bunny The Killer Thing
programme.desc: A group of Finnish and British people get stuck at a cabin when they are attacked by a creature that is a half human, half rabbit.

programme.title: Captain Orellana and the Possessed Village
programme.desc: Captain Orellana, a former police investigator has been tapped for the wackiest, most dangerous case of his long career. He’s hired to examine the strange occurrences in a remote village in which many of the villages seem to be … POSSESSED! With 007-like swagger Orellana takes on the challenge.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: A teenage girl is baby sitting at a new house when she's accosted by a vicious, possessed doll. With the baby sitter in bondage, the toy subjects her to a series of terrifying tales on the television, each story more twisted than the last.

programme.title: CERN & The Sense of Beauty
programme.desc: An exploration of the link between science and beauty through the work of scientists at CERN, in Geneva.

programme.title: Cannibal
programme.desc: Max is agoraphobic and lives in a cabin in the middle of nowhere. One night, he finds a beautiful unconscious woman (Bianca). Her body is covered with blood.

programme.title: Border Blues
programme.desc: A dangerous smuggler helps an attractive woman and her 5-year-old daughter, while a police chief pursues a mad bomber in Los Angeles. Starring Eric Roberts, Gary Busey, Rodion Nahapetov

programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.
